name: claim_my_kpi
xsql:
SELECT FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Draft'     THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS draft_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Submitted' THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS submitted_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Approved'  THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS approved_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Rejected'  THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS rejected_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0), '$#,###0.00')                           AS filtered_value,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Approved' THEN c.claim_amount END), 0), '$#,###0.00') AS approved_value
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.employee_id = :v_employee_id
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_period, '') = '' OR Nvl(:v_period, '') = 'All' OR c.period_name = :v_period )
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_status, '') = '' OR Nvl(:v_status, '') = 'All' OR c.status      = :v_status )
